models.title: Additivity of disjoint observation counts
models.summary: Joint frequencies add to marginal counts, and ordered bins accumulate to cumulative counts.

relationship.original_equation: Marginal frequency = sum of joint frequencies over the complementary categories; cumulative frequency = ordered prefix sum.
relationship.locator: Section 1.3, Frequency and cumulative relative frequency, Tables1.10-1.12
relationship.translation_notes: One generic count-union definition captures both marginal and cumulative variants, avoiding separate sum-only clones. Counts are dimensionless numbers of observations and sum to counts. Financial cash-flow additivity uses a different scientific quantity and currency units. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.

models.title: Expected contingency-table cell count under independence
models.summary: Under the independence hypothesis each expected cell count is the product of its row and column totals divided by the overall count.

relationship.original_equation: Expected Value_i,j = (Total Row_i * Total Column_j)/Overall Total
relationship.translation_notes: Count*count/count yields count. E can be fractional even when all observed margins are integers. Row and column margins must come from one consistent table. This is not a forecast of a future financial event. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.
